name: Paypercut BNPL for WooCommerce
author: Paypercut Dev

sections.description:
Paypercut BNPL for WooCommerce enables your customers to split their purchases into manageable monthly installments. This plugin seamlessly integrates with Paypercut’s BNPL service, providing a smooth checkout experience while increasing conversion rates and average order values.

Key Features

  • Buy Now Pay Later Integration – Seamlessly integrate Paypercut BNPL into your WooCommerce store
  • 4-Installment Payment Plans – Customers can split purchases into 4 equal monthly payments
  • Sandbox Testing – Built-in test mode for development and testing
  • Admin Dashboard – Comprehensive admin interface for configuration and monitoring
  • Responsive Design – Mobile-friendly checkout experience
  • Order Management – Full integration with WooCommerce order management
  • Email Notifications – Automatic email notifications with BNPL details
  • Security – Secure API communication with proper validation
  • HPOS Compatible – Supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Blocks Compatible – Works with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks

How It Works

  1. Customer Checkout – Customer selects “Buy Now, Pay Later” at checkout
  2. Paypercut Processing – Customer is redirected to Paypercut’s secure platform
  3. Payment Plan – Customer reviews and accepts the 4-installment payment plan
  4. Order Completion – Customer is redirected back to your store with order confirmation
  5. Payment Collection – Paypercut handles all installment collections automatically

Benefits for Store Owners

  • Increased Conversions – Reduce cart abandonment with flexible payment options
  • Higher AOV – Customers can afford larger purchases with installment plans
  • Risk-Free – Paypercut assumes all payment risk and collection responsibility
  • Easy Integration – Simple setup with comprehensive admin dashboard
  • Real-time Monitoring – Track payment status and performance

Benefits for Customers

  • Flexible Payments – Split purchases into 4 manageable monthly payments
  • Interest-Free – No interest charges on approved purchases
  • Quick Approval – Fast approval process with minimal documentation
  • Secure – Bank-level security for all transactions
  • Transparent – Clear payment terms and schedules

Configuration

Getting Started

  1. Install and Activate the plugin
  2. Get API Credentials from Paypercut Dashboard
  3. Configure Gateway in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Test Integration using sandbox mode
  5. Go Live with production credentials

Gateway Settings

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Paypercut BNPL to configure:

  • Enable/Disable – Turn the gateway on or off
  • Title – Payment method title shown to customers
  • Description – Payment method description
  • Test Mode – Enable for testing, disable for live transactions
  • API Key – Your Paypercut API Key
  • API Secret – Your Paypercut API Secret
  • Minimum Amount – Minimum order amount for BNPL (default: €10)
  • Maximum Amount – Maximum order amount for BNPL (default: €1,500)

Testing

  1. Enable Test Mode in gateway settings
  2. Use Sandbox Credentials from Paypercut dashboard
  3. Create Test Orders with different amounts
  4. Verify Payment Flow and order completion
  5. Check Email Notifications

Support

Documentation

  • Paypercut API Documentation
  • WooCommerce Payment Gateway Guide

Getting Help

  • Paypercut Support Center
  • WooCommerce Support

Plugin Support

  • Check plugin settings and configuration
  • Review error logs and debug information
  • Test with sandbox credentials first
  • Ensure WooCommerce and WordPress are up to date

Requirements

  • WordPress: 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce: 5.0 or higher
  • PHP: 7.4 or higher
  • SSL Certificate: Required for live payments
  • Paypercut Account: Active merchant account with API credentials

Security

  • All API communications are encrypted using HTTPS
  • API signatures are validated for security
  • Sensitive data is properly handled and not stored
  • Regular security updates are provided
  • Follows WordPress coding standards and security best practices

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit pull requests or open issues for bugs and feature requests.

Note: This plugin requires active Paypercut API credentials and a valid WooCommerce installation. Always test in sandbox mode before going live.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Paypercut BNPL Gateway”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

FTP Installation

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
sections.faq:
What is Paypercut BNPL?

Paypercut BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) is a payment service that allows customers to split their purchases into 4 equal monthly installments without interest charges.

How do customers pay?

Customers make 4 equal monthly payments. The first payment is due immediately, and the remaining 3 payments are automatically collected monthly.

Is there any interest or fees for customers?

No, customers pay no interest or additional fees when using Paypercut BNPL (subject to Paypercut’s terms and conditions).

What are the minimum and maximum purchase amounts?

Minimum purchase: €10
Maximum purchase: €1,500

Do I need to sign up with Paypercut?

Yes, you need to create a Paypercut merchant account and obtain API credentials to use this plugin.

How do I get Paypercut API credentials?

  1. Visit Paypercut Dashboard
  2. Create a merchant account
  3. Navigate to API settings
  4. Generate your API Key and Secret

Can I test the integration before going live?

Yes, the plugin includes a test mode that allows you to test the integration using Paypercut’s sandbox environment.

What currencies are supported?

Currently supports EUR (Euro). Additional currencies may be added in future updates.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Does the plugin support High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage feature.
